A good Reference Data system prevents thousands of duplicate values, inconsistent spelling, migration problems, reporting errors, and integration headaches.

sections.title: 🚀 Phase 10 — Business Layer
paragraphs: Our next entity will be Customer.
And I don't want to treat it as just another CRM contact.
I want Customer to become the Business Relationship Engine of KoreVity.
Every module—Sales, Support, Finance, Projects, Documents, AI, Analytics—will revolve around that single Customer entity.
If we design it correctly, we'll never need separate "CRM customers," "Accounting customers," or "Support customers." There will be one Customer, with many relationships.
I think that will be one of the defining strengths of KoreVity's architecture.
